newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Pelwatte up 2.7 pct on growth prospects.
newsitem.headline: Pelwatte up 2.7 pct on growth prospects.

text.p: Shares in Pelwatte Sugar Co Ltd rose by 2.7 percent, or 25 cents, to 9.50 rupees on Wednesday morning on beliefs the company will post a good profit growth in the current financial year, brokers said.
"The company is expected to see a net profit increase of about 10.5 percent to 147 million in the year to March, 1997," said a John Keells analyst.
The stock is also cheap and liquid, making it easier for investors to seek quick profits, one local broker said.
The rise in the stock was on a volume of 34,000 shares, brokers said.
